title: St. Catherine of Alexandria, Virgin and Martyr
subtitle: Optional Memorial · Rev 15:1-4; Lk 21:12-19
text: According to ancient tradition, Catherine was a learned young woman of Alexandria who defended the faith so well that the philosophers sent to refute her came to believe, and she was martyred in the early fourth century. In today's Gospel Jesus promises his witnesses a wisdom their adversaries cannot resist. Learn the faith well, and trust Christ to speak through you.
